text:
nina-peopleops: Quick Q from Ashley's team 7 promos this cycle. What's the minimal doc set to submit for manager-approved IC promos (no equity, just base + bonus) to hit Sept 1 effective?

ashley-manager: Need to confirm payroll cutoff + whether one combined CSV is ok for multiple people.

zack-eng: Also curious about rounding policy or salary bands or USD salaries when managers propose odd amounts (e.g., $102,345). Do we round to nearest 5 or allow cents?

mira-legal: For straight base+bonus with no earnouts/equity, legal review not required. If any promo includes retention clauses or post-termination payouts, loop legal.

courtney-payroll: Cutoff for Sept 1 effective is Fri Aug 23 5pm PT for standard domestic changes. We need one canonical CSV and signed manager approval PDFs per employee by cutoff. You can upload multiple employee rows in one CSV (preferred).

hr-bot: Template reminder: https://redwood.infra/people-ops/comp-change-template.csv. Required headers: employee_id, email, effective_date, base_amount, bonus_amount, currency, notes.

ashley-manager: About rounding?

courtney-payroll: Payroll prefers whole dollars. We round to nearest dollar on upload. If manager submits cents, payroll will truncate cents and record rounding in notes. If band policy requires 5s rounding, people ops will enforce during review.

nina-peopleops: Checklist I'm hearing: 1) canonical CSV (one file for all promos ok), 2) manager approval PDFs per person, 3) confirm no equity/earnout in notes, 4) submit by Aug 23 5pm PT. Anything else?

ashely-manager: Small Q: If one approval is late, can we do a retro?

mira-legal: Retro allowed up to 3 pay cycles back for processing errors; requires manager reason and people ops sign-off. Anything with >$10k total retro payout needs comp committee notice.

nina-peopleops: Great. I'll create case #7701 and upload a draft CSV for review tomorrow. Ping me direct if approvals lag. :thumbsup:
